digest.component_or_area: LLM gate usage recording and diagnostics
propositions: Gate run usage metrics (requests, tool-calls, distinct tool-call signatures) are computed by failure_usage() but discarded at the write, leaving no durable record for tuning decisions.
A local operator running a gate with no REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var set records no usage data at all, making diagnosis require multiple live instrumented re-runs instead of a query.
The success path never computes tool-call counts or duration, while the failure path computes them but drops them before write, creating path asymmetry.
Loop-vs-breadth discrimination requires the distinct-to-total tool-call ratio, which cannot be computed without persisting both counts alongside the request limits under which the run operated.
The usage_log.record() function filters input through a fixed _FIELDS allowlist that omits seven keys already computed by failure_usage(), violating the module's own docstring contract.
